secrets.name: AUTODATA_BANKTWO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Banktwo source-connector API key (https://banktwo.cars.tk). Required to hydrate the vehicle catalog that the Workshop and /v1/catalog/* browse. The stack boots without it, but catalog lookups return no years until it is set.

secrets.name: AUTODATA_BANKONE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bankone source-connector API key (https://bankone.cars.tk). Used by the bankone batch/article ingestion paths; optional for browsing the preview.

secrets.name: INCEPTION_API_KEY
secrets.description: Inception Labs API key for the Mercury2 job-plan and procedure-composition features. Optional: the deterministic local path does not need it.
